metadata.title: Intelligenzia – Cognitive Science Alumni Society
metadata.description: Intelligenzia is a cognitive science alumni society founded in 1989 at the University of Helsinki.

hero.title: The cognitive science alumni society
hero.description: Intelligenzia brings together people who studied cognitive science at the University of Helsinki and those now working in the field. We run events, keep the alumni network going, and publish a glossary of the field.

field.title: What is cognitive science?
field.body1: Cognitive science studies the mind and how it works: perception, memory, language, learning, and reasoning. It isn't one discipline but a question six of them share: how does the mind process information?
field.body2: The field began in the 1950s, when psychologists, linguists, and computer scientists found they were studying the same thing by different methods. Cognitive science has been taught at the University of Helsinki since 1989.

hexagon.aria: The cognitive science hexagon: six disciplines and the interdisciplines between them.
hexagon.hint: Point at or select a discipline to see its interfaces.
